description:
EARTHSONIC

We are a team of technology and science enthusiasts passionate about innovation, creativity, accessibility, and exploring new ways to understand our planet. Our interests include software engineering, data analysis, UI/UX design, artificial intelligence, sound design, and Earth science. Through EARTHSONIC, we aim to transform NASA's Earth visualizations and scientific data into meaningful auditory experiences, making Earth science more engaging and accessible, especially for people.
summary:
EARTHSONIC is an interactive web-based science platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, addressing the challenge *The Earth Information Jukebox.
The project explores how Earth science visualizations can be transformed into meaningful audio experiences through data sonification. Rather than relying solely on visual representations, EARTHSONIC aims to help people experience and understand changes in Earth's systems through sound.
The platform focuses on three initial phenomena: ocean currents, global temperature and lightning activity. Its proposed approach involves obtaining scientific visualizations, extracting meaningful patterns, mapping those patterns to sound characteristics such as pitch, rhythm and intensity, and generating synchronized audio experiences.
EARTHSONIC also emphasizes accessibility, particularly for people who are blind or have low vision, by exploring sound as an additional way to understand scientific information.
Current Development Status: The project currently has a deployed web interface with navigation, phenomenon exploration pages, project information and an explanation of the proposed sonification workflow. NASA visualization integration, automated data extraction and audio synthesis are planned development stages.
Our Vision:To make Earth science more accessible, engaging and understandable by allowing people not only to see the changes happening on our planet, but also to hear them.
details:
EARTHSONIC — Hear the Planet. Understand the Change.

EARTHSONIC is an interactive web platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, under The Earth Information Jukebox. It uses data sonification to transform visual patterns from Earth science visualizations into meaningful audio experiences.

By analysing changes in visual frames and mapping them to sound characteristics such as pitch, intensity, and rhythm, the platform offers an alternative way to explore phenomena like ocean currents, global temperature, and lightning activity.

Built with React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, alongside browser-based visual and audio technologies, EARTHSONIC promotes accessible science communication, particularly for people who are blind or have low vision.

Its goal is to make understanding our planet more interactive, inclusive, and engaging by allowing people not only to see Earth's changes, but also to hear them.
